purpose: Background extraction of four owner-supplied avatar sheets; image edits do not imply pixel identity with originals.

Remove ALL nine rounded-square pastel background tiles, the outer white background, and the oval ground shadows. Keep ONLY the nine original mascot silhouettes with their eyes, ears, horns, tails, body markings, original colours, highlights, shading, proportions and exact identities. Do not invent or redesign any character. Preserve every disconnected character part. Deliver one square RGBA transparent PNG sprite sheet with EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows in the SAME source reading order. Each complete mascot must be inside its own equal square cell with generous transparent margins; center it in that cell; never overlap cell boundaries. Actual alpha transparency outside the mascots, including spaces between ears and antlers. No tile, badge, frame, backdrop, checkerboard pixels, text, outline, or ground shadows. Keep pale cream and white body areas fully opaque; do not erase them as background. Used as individual avatars on white and dark app backgrounds. Source identities by row: pink rabbit, brown bear, cream-and-orange patch cat; orange fox with tail, yellow chick-like tufted mascot, green frog; panda, lavender-blue mouse, spotted fawn with antlers.
